name: Input
description: Collects a single line of user-entered text.

constraints: Use for format hints only, not as a replacement for labels

type.description: HTML input type for validation and keyboard

required.description: Whether the field is required (shows asterisk)

helperText.description: Helper or error message below input

startAdornment.description: Content rendered before the input (icon or prefix text)

endAdornment.description: Content rendered after the input (icon or suffix text)

shortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut hint displayed as a visual kbd token inside the input

shortcutBehavior.description: Whether shortcut hint is visual only or also registers a global focus hotkey

onChange.description: Called with new value on change

onValueChange.description: Value-first change callback alias: (value: string) => void

rootProps.description: HTML attributes applied to the wrapper element

inputStyle.description: Inline styles applied directly to the input element

inputClassName.description: Class name applied directly to the input element

withFieldWrapper.description: Render built-in label/helper wrapper (set false for Field composition or bare input rendering)

when: Single-line answers: name, email, password, phone, URL
Short free-form values a list cannot cover
guidelines: Match type to the data — it drives validation and mobile keyboards
Placeholder shows format; it never replaces the label
Pair error with helperText so the reason is announced
Use the shortcut prop for kbd hints instead of custom markup
shortcut is display-only; shortcutBehavior="focus-input" adds the global hotkey
accessibility: Label is programmatically tied to the input
Error text is announced to screen readers

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Label plus a placeholder that hints the format.

examples.name: With Value
examples.description: Starts with a value already in the field.

examples.name: With Helper
examples.description: Supporting text sits under the field.
examples.code:
<Input
  label="Password"
  type="password"
  placeholder="Create a password"
  helperText="Must be at least 8 characters"
/>

examples.name: Error State
examples.description: Red border, and helperText becomes the reason.
examples.code:
<Input
  label="Email"
  type="email"
  value="invalid-email"
  error
  helperText="Please enter a valid email address"
/>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Dimmed, unfocusable, still shows its value.

examples.name: Required
examples.description: Asterisk marks the field as mandatory.

examples.name: Sizes
Bare Input (Field Composition)
examples.description: Drops the built-in label wrapper so Field owns the layout.

examples.name: Search With Shortcut
examples.description: Leading icon and a ⌘K hint that focuses the field.
examples.code:
<Input
  aria-label="Search findings"
  placeholder="Search findings..."
  shortcut="⌘K"
  shortcutBehavior="focus-input"
  startAdornment={<MagnifyingGlass aria-hidden="true" />}
  withFieldWrapper={false}
/>

examples.name: Success State
examples.description: Green border confirms the value passed validation.
examples.code:
<Input
  label="Email"
  type="email"
  value="user@example.com"
  success
  helperText="Email verified"
/>

examples.name: With Start Adornment
examples.description: Prefix sits inside the field, before the text.

examples.name: With End Adornment
examples.description: Suffix sits inside the field, after the text.

relations.note: Use Textarea for multi-line text input
Use Select when choosing from predefined options
Use Field for advanced form composition and custom controls

propsSummary: startAdornment: ReactNode - content before the input (icon or prefix)
endAdornment: ReactNode - content after the input (icon or suffix)
shortcut: string - visual kbd hint inside the input; do not hand-roll extra kbd markup
onValueChange: (value: string) => void - value-first change callback alias
withFieldWrapper: boolean - toggle built-in wrapper/label rendering (default: true)
...native input attributes are supported (autoComplete, required, inputMode, pattern, etc.)
